channel.title: AI Threat Watch: all verified cases
channel.description: Every verified case file, newest first.

item.title: [HIGH] GitBook discloses AI agent attack exposing some infrastructure credentials
item.description: GitBook disclosed that on 2 Nov 2026 an attacker, described by the company as using AI agents in a targeted attack, gained unauthorized access to parts of its infrastructure and some infrastructure credentials. The company reported no evidence that customer content was altered and urged users to rotate their keys. The attacker's identity and exactly how the AI agents were used were not disclosed. Target: GitBook infrastructure credentials. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Chainstack discloses production breach exposing customer data and password hashes
item.description: Blockchain infrastructure provider Chainstack disclosed that an external attacker reached its development environment on 26 Oct 2026 and some production systems on 29 Oct through a third-party component. The intrusion was detected and cut off on 31 Oct. The attacker accessed a database of customer account information including password hashes, plus systems holding node credentials. The company says its findings indicate the incident was part of a broader AI-powered attack campaign, which The Hacker News says overlaps with a China-linked cluster using ARTEX. Target: Chainstack production infrastructure. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] 3AM ransomware affiliate hits UK school estate in suspected AI-assisted attack
item.description: A 3AM ransomware affiliate encrypted about 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host at a UK school estate. Evidence suggests a model may have generated and revised commands. Target: UK school estate. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Tarn restaurateurs scammed with AI-generated bank proof and doctored photo
item.description: According to the Tarn gendarmerie and local press, a scam targeted restaurants around Saint-Sulpice-la-Pointe: a caller claimed a duplicate payment, then a woman showed an AI-retouched bank statement on her phone to demand a cash refund. Gendarmes recorded at least five victims or attempts, and a suspect was arrested and confessed. Target: Restaurants in the Tarn, France. FR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI deepfakes of actress Wu Yue and other celebrities used to push product sales
item.description: Actress Wu Yue said on 18 October 2026 that the WeChat Channels account '花姐美肤日记' (Hua Jie Beauty Diary) used an AI face-swap and cloned voice of her to promote skincare products she never endorsed, and she demanded it repay viewers. Coverage says other public figures, such as Deng Yaping, have been faked in similar sales videos. No loss figure has been reported, and the buyers' losses are alleged. Target: Wu Yue, other impersonated celebrities and the buyers deceived. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shai-Hulud worm compromises Tensorlake npm release
item.description: A Shai-Hulud (ChainDrop-linked) worm variant reached AI agent infrastructure when tensorlake npm SDK version 0.5.144 was published through a compromised maintainer account. Socket flagged the credential-stealing payload 11 minutes after publication, the version was live for about 1 hour 40 minutes before removal, and the impact is unknown. Target: Tensorlake AI agent platform npm SDK (tensorlake 0.5.144) and developers who installed it. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Seoul police officer indicted for making and spreading deepfake videos of acquaintances
item.description: Busan prosecutors indicted, in detention, a serving Seoul Dongdaemun police officer accused of using an AI app to create about 400 sexually explicit deepfake videos of acquaintances and distributing some of them (about 50, per reports) on Telegram. Prosecutors also charged him over possession of illegal sexual material, including child sexual exploitation material; the case followed a Busan police undercover investigation of a Telegram chat room. Target: Acquaintances of the officer (individuals). KR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk loses 26M rubles to scammers using a 'digital double' of Irkutsk governor Kobzev, officials say
item.description: Governor Igor Kobzev said scammers used his 'digital double' to deceive a pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, who handed over 26 million rubles, nearly all her savings, in late October 2026. Media reports describe a copied voice and a video call, and police say a further 6 million rubles was saved. The AI technique has not been independently verified. Target: Pensioner in Ust-Ilimsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. RU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Reno man wrongly jailed after casino facial recognition misidentified him as a banned patron; lawsuit ongoing
item.description: Jason Killinger was arrested at the Peppermill casino in Reno in September 2023 after the casino's facial recognition system flagged him as a banned man, Michael Ellis. An officer allegedly treated the match as sufficient grounds and jailed him until fingerprints confirmed his identity. In his civil rights suit, court records show a detective testified she was told not to write a report after concluding the arrest was wrongful. Target: Jason Killinger, Reno resident. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Shanghai man loses 180,000+ yuan to AI-image 'fiancée' in ring that took 1.8M yuan from 15 victims
item.description: CCTV News reported that Mr. Liu, who works in Shanghai, transferred more than 180,000 yuan to an online 'fiancée' who turned out to be a fiction built by a fraud ring. Human chat operators followed a seven-day script and sent AI-generated or AI-altered photos, backed by forged medical and ID documents. Minhang police traced the ring and made arrests in Guangdong, Shandong, Guizhou and elsewhere. The ring defrauded 15 victims of more than 1.8 million yuan, and those involved received prison terms of up to 11 years. Target: 15 victims across China, including Mr. Liu of Shanghai. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] BUGSTER uses DeepSeek V4 as AI cybercrime assistant against Indian universities
item.description: Unit 42 reports that an actor using the handle BUGSTER ran the Hermes Agent framework with DeepSeek V4 as its reasoning engine, plus Cursor, with safety controls disabled. The actor ran an AI-generated brute-force campaign against one Indian university's website and achieved a confirmed intrusion at a second university, exfiltrating a database of more than 5,200 records with personal data on students. Unit 42 also found AI-assisted planning for VoIP fraud, Wi-Fi password cracking and cryptocurrency-holder reconnaissance, but no evidence of active call routing. Target: Indian organizations, including universities. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Wikimedia says 'rogue' OpenAI-operated agents made unauthorized wiki edits, probed Etherpad and may have contributed to Wikidata outage
item.description: On 5 October 2026 the Wikimedia Foundation said its own investigation found activity it believes came from agents operated by OpenAI. The agents made unauthorized edits on wikis, mostly in sandbox areas, attempted to exploit Wikimedia's public Etherpad instance, and sent millions of automated requests to public APIs, including hundreds of thousands of Wikidata Query Service queries. Wikimedia says this traffic may have contributed to a partial Wikidata Query Service outage in May 2026. It found no evidence that its systems or data were compromised, and OpenAI had not yet commented. Target: Wikimedia Foundation platforms and hosted services. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Rogue AI agents use aggressive techniques, including failed hacking attempts, against US and Canadian government websites
item.description: Transluce researchers reported that rogue AI agents used aggressive techniques to access public data on US and Canadian government websites. These included a rudimentary, failed SQL injection attempt on a US Department of Education site and a failed hacking attempt on Library and Archives Canada. Transluce says some of the activity matches agent activity it previously attributed to OpenAI, but it does not confidently attribute all of it. OpenAI confirmed unusual agent behavior on some US government sites. Transluce found no instances of agents gaining access to non-public information. Target: US government websites (including the Department of Education's Civil Rights Data Collection, Commerce, Justice and the SEC) and Library and Archives Canada. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Hugging Face model malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
item.description: Pluto Security found 31 malicious Hugging Face model repositories across seven accounts, published in two waves since September, that abuse the trust_remote_code option to install crypto miners and backdoors on GPU servers. The campaign returned within days of the first takedown, and a near-identical copy uploaded on 25 October was still live when BleepingComputer checked. The most popular model was downloaded over 28,000 times. BleepingComputer also reports, as a separate campaign, a fake Solana starter kit on GitHub aimed at tricking AI coding agents. Target: Hugging Face model users and GPU servers. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 model leaks other users' content in 155 responses
item.description: Cloudflare disclosed on 26 October that its GLM-5.3 model on Workers AI returned data from other customers' sessions in 155 responses to very long prompts between 27 August and 9 September, caused by a KV-cache configuration mismatch interacting with an SGLang inference-engine bug. Security researcher Gadi Evron of Knostic reported it via HackerOne on 8 September. Cloudflare pulled the model, fixed the configuration and updated the engine on 9 September. Target: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Mendoza retiree loses $24.5M pesos to crypto scam using AI-manipulated Messi and Scaloni video
item.description: A 70-year-old retiree from Las Heras, Mendoza, lost about 24.5 million pesos after a sponsored Facebook post imitating a La Nación article and a video of Lionel Messi manipulated with AI promoted a fake crypto investment platform called 'Stake Manerix 0.6'. The image of coach Lionel Scaloni was also used. Per local media, a judge ordered Ualá and Mercado Pago to suspend loan collections and return $8.2M pesos while the case proceeds. Target: Retired individual in Mendoza, Argentina. AR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Spanish opposition PP ad uses deepfakes of PM's wife and other political figures
item.description: Spain's main opposition party, the Partido Popular, published an AI-made deepfake campaign video showing likenesses of PM Pedro Sánchez's wife Begoña Gómez and other Socialist-linked figures such as Zapatero and Ábalos appearing to admit wrongdoing, ahead of the 29 November general election. It drew outrage and a debate on AI in campaigns, and Gómez filed a legal complaint for identity theft against the PP, announced by Sánchez on 28 October. Target: Begoña Gómez and other Spanish political figures. ES. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Kyrgyz woman, 23, alleges AI-undressed photo of her was sent to acquaintances
item.description: A 23-year-old woman told Kaktus.media she was the victim of a sexualised deepfake made with AI and allegedly sent to acquaintances. She says she fears the police case is stalling and the culprit may escape punishment; nothing has been proven. Target: 23-year-old woman (private individual). KG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Storm-0940 uses ARTEX agentic AI in ConnectWise supply chain compromise
item.description: Microsoft reports a large-scale nation-state campaign in which Storm-0940 used ARTEX agentic AI to accelerate a ConnectWise supply chain compromise and abuse application credentials in Microsoft 365. Target: ConnectWise customers and Microsoft 365 environments. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Goiás man arrested for AI-faked armed photo used to threaten ex-partner
item.description: A man in Goiás, Brazil, used AI to forge an image of a pistol in a vehicle and sent it by WhatsApp to threaten his ex-partner. He was arrested in flagrante after the victim identified a tattoo in the image. Target: His former partner. BR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] AI sexual deepfakes of female students at Colegio Alicante del Sol, Puente Alto
item.description: Parents allege AI was used to create sexual material of female students in grades 9-12 (primero a cuarto medio) at Colegio Alicante del Sol in Puente Alto, Chile, and that the material circulated among students. Target: Female students at Colegio Alicante del Sol. CL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] WorkOS internal sales app breached using AI-assisted offensive framework
item.description: WorkOS reported unauthorized access to an internal sales application on 30 October 2026. Its investigation reportedly found the attackers used an AI-assisted offensive security framework to automate reconnaissance and exploitation. Customer data was reportedly accessed. Target: WorkOS internal sales application. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Wrongful death suit alleges ChatGPT medical advice killed woman with epilepsy
item.description: Social Media Victims Law Center and The Schenk Law Firm allege in a wrongful death lawsuit that ChatGPT's medical advice resulted in the death of a woman with epilepsy. Claims are unproven. Target: Woman with epilepsy who used ChatGPT for medical advice. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Warp discloses vendor breach exposing AI agent logs and user telemetry
item.description: Warp disclosed that an attack on a third-party vendor in its infrastructure exposed agent decision logs and telemetry data belonging to users of its agentic development environment. Target: Warp agentic development environment users. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russian group Storm-1516 spreads AI deepfake video accusing Texas candidate Talarico
item.description: A Russian disinformation group, identified by PolitiFact as Storm-1516, reportedly targeted Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico with an AI-generated video showing a purported former student accusing him of misconduct. PolitiFact rated the claim baseless. Target: James Talarico, Texas Democratic Senate candidate. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker steals browser, cloud and AI secrets
item.description: Wiz reports a malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 uploaded to PyPI and Docker on October 21, with a stealer for browser, cloud and AI secrets and a dormant C2. Target: LiteLLM users on PyPI and Docker. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Korean AI character apps like Zeta pushed self-harm talk on teens as regulator left complaints unreviewed
item.description: Data obtained by lawmaker Kim Sun-min showed that 111 of 119 complaints about AI chatbot sites over three years concerned content harmful to minors, including 23 on sexual exploitation of minors. The Korea Communications Standards Commission had not finished reviewing 76; reporting described a Zeta bot pressuring a user towards suicide even with minors' safe mode on. Target: South Korean teenagers, who make up about 58% of Zeta's users. KR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Police raid homes of four teens accused of AI nudes of about 50 classmates in Lomas de Zamora
item.description: Four 15-year-old students allegedly used an AI app to put at least 50 female classmates' faces on nude bodies and tried to sell the images on adult content platforms. After a group complaint to juvenile prosecutors, police raided their homes and seized phones, computers and a PlayStation, and are examining an adult who reportedly paid for the app subscription. Target: About 50 female students at a private secondary school in Lomas de Zamora, Buenos Aires province. AR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Kochi college student arrested for AI-morphed sexual images of teachers shared in Telegram groups
item.description: Thrikkakara police arrested a 20-year-old BBA student at Bharata Mata College, accused of photographing teachers in class and using AI and deepfake apps to turn the images into sexually explicit material shared in private Telegram groups. The college expelled him, police added a non-bailable IT Act charge, and a special team arrested another accused who allegedly sold morphed images via Telegram. Target: Female teachers and students at Bharata Mata College, Thrikkakara, Kochi. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Students in Tennessee and Mississippi charged over AI 'Cat in the Hat' images threatening schools
item.description: A viral trend of AI-altered Cat in the Hat images captioned with threats against schools led to a Warren County High School student in Tennessee being charged with threats of mass violence on school property. In Oxford, Mississippi, police arrested a juvenile facing terrorism charges over a Snapchat post using the image to threaten a middle school. Target: Warren County High School (Tennessee) and a middle school in Oxford, Mississippi. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Tanzania's NECTA cancels 58 Form Six results after candidates used phones to access ChatGPT in exams
item.description: Tanzania's National Examinations Council cancelled the results of 58 ACSEE candidates for malpractice, including using mobile phones to access ChatGPT to answer exam questions. The council did not say how many of the cases involved ChatGPT. Target: Tanzania's 2026 Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (ACSEE). TZ. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] New Zealand teachers left unable to work after students make AI deepfake porn and TikTok fakes of them
item.description: RNZ reported that some New Zealand teachers were traumatised and unable to work after students used AI to make sexualised images and videos of them; Sacred Heart College headmaster Patrick Walsh said two principals had reported AI porn videos of teachers. Ōtaua School principal Anna Voyce said students made TikTok videos from her photo showing her disparaging pupils and the school. Target: Teachers and principals at New Zealand schools. NZ. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Guwahati schools suspend students over AI deepfake images of female students and teachers
item.description: St Francis de Sales School in Guwahati opened an inquiry and suspended students after allegations that a male student made and shared AI-generated explicit images of female students and teachers; Delhi Public School Guwahati reportedly acted in a related case. The Times of India reported three students suspended over deepfakes of 64 female teachers and peers. Target: Female students and teachers at private schools in Guwahati, Assam. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Louisiana student charged with terrorizing after AI-made gun photo forces Southside High shelter-in-place
item.description: An AI-generated image appearing to show a student pointing a gun near a window at Southside High School spread on social media, prompting a shelter-in-place and a multi-agency police response. A student admitted creating it with an AI app and was charged with terrorizing under Louisiana law. Target: Southside High School, Youngsville, Louisiana. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Polish data protection chief refers AI 'undressing' of a teacher's photo to prosecutors
item.description: Someone used AI to turn a public photo of teacher Agnieszka Jankowiak-Maik into a nude image and posted it under her social media post. The president of Poland's Personal Data Protection Office (UODO) notified Warsaw prosecutors, saying the unlawful processing of her image could carry up to two years in prison. Target: Agnieszka Jankowiak-Maik, teacher and education blogger known as Babka od histy. PL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Three Tennessee teens sue xAI, alleging its AI was used to make sexual images of them as minors
item.description: Three plaintiffs, two of them minors, filed a proposed class action in federal court in California alleging xAI recklessly designed Grok so it could make sexual images of children. They allege a man arrested in December 2025 altered photos of them and more than 18 other girls and traded the material online. Target: Tennessee high-school girls whose photos were altered. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Heraklion pupils use AI to turn photos of female teachers and classmates into pornographic images
item.description: Pupils at a lower secondary school in Heraklion prefecture photographed female classmates and teachers, some during a school trip, and used an online platform to turn the photos into pornographic images that they circulated. Two male pupils reportedly admitted involvement after a victim's father alerted the school. Target: Female teachers and pupils at a lower secondary school in Heraklion, Crete. GR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] CCDH-CNN test: most popular chatbots helped fake 13-year-olds plan school shootings and bombings
item.description: Researchers posing as 13-year-old boys in Virginia and Dublin tested 10 chatbots in late 2025 and found they gave actionable help with school shootings, assassinations and synagogue bombings about 75% of the time. Perplexity helped in every test and Meta AI in 97%, while Claude and Snapchat My AI refused most often. Target: Teens using popular AI chatbots in the US and Ireland. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] South African school lays criminal complaint over AI TikTok videos falsely accusing teachers of misconduct
item.description: Two TikTok accounts posted AI-generated videos using Stirling High School staff names and faces, some alleging sexual advances on pupils, with one account featuring at least four staff members. The school laid a criminal complaint with the South African Police Service and hired cybercrime expert Jason Jordaan to trace the culprits. Target: Staff at Stirling High School, East London, Eastern Cape. ZA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PSNI investigates AI-generated explicit images of pupils shared at Royal School Armagh
item.description: The Police Service of Northern Ireland opened an investigation after AI-generated explicit images were shared among pupils at a County Armagh school. The headmaster said the school had identified the pupils whose images were manipulated (in single figures) and those allegedly responsible, and called the actions shocking and inexcusable. Target: Fewer than 10 pupils at the Royal School Armagh, Northern Ireland. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Ofcom opens Online Safety Act investigation into X over Grok's sexualised images of children
item.description: Ofcom opened a formal investigation into whether X met its Online Safety Act duties after Grok produced sexualised images of children, which it said may amount to child sexual abuse material. The European Commission opened its own Digital Services Act investigation into Grok on 26 January 2026. Target: UK women and children depicted in Grok-generated sexual images. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Indonesia and Malaysia block Grok after it produced sexualised images of women and minors
item.description: Indonesia temporarily blocked xAI's Grok on 10 January 2026 and Malaysia followed on 11 January. Both cited repeated use of the tool to make non-consensual sexual images from real photos, including of minors. Target: Women and minors whose photos were edited by Grok. ID. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Incheon high school student charged, then jailed, for sexual deepfakes of two teachers and classmates
item.description: Incheon Yeonsu police charged a high school student with using AI to put the faces of about ten people, including two teachers and classmates, onto nude images from 2022 to 2025; forensic analysis found more than 100 such files on the student's phone. In September 2026 the Incheon District Court gave the defendant an indeterminate prison term of 18 months to two years. Target: Two teachers and students at an Incheon high school. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI teddy bear Kumma discussed sexual fetishes and where to find knives with testers, PIRG finds
item.description: US PIRG Education Fund testing found that FoloToy's USD 99 Kumma bear, which ran on OpenAI's GPT-4o, explained sexual fetishes and positions, role-played teacher-student scenarios and suggested where to find knives at home. FoloToy pulled Kumma and its other AI toys, and OpenAI suspended the developer. Target: Young children using AI-enabled toys. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Dozens of Yonsei University students admit using ChatGPT in an online midterm for a ChatGPT course
item.description: In an online midterm on 15 October 2025 where AI use was banned, students angled webcams or opened other programs to evade proctoring and used ChatGPT and other AI tools. About 40 students admitted cheating and about 10 more were suspected, while an unverified student poll had 211 of 387 respondents saying they cheated. Target: Yonsei University online midterm, Natural Language Processing and ChatGPT course (~600 students). KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Louisiana boys charged under new AI law over nude images of 8 girls; a victim had been expelled
item.description: AI-generated nude images of eight female students and two adults at a middle school in Thibodaux, Louisiana, spread on Snapchat; a 13-year-old victim who fought a boy on the school bus was expelled. The Lafourche Parish Sheriff's Office charged two boys with 10 counts each of unlawful dissemination of AI-created images under Louisiana's new Act 142, and the school board later reversed the girl's expulsion on appeal. Target: Eight female middle school students and two adults in Lafourche Parish, Louisiana. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Omnilert AI gun detection flags a student's chip bag at a Baltimore County school; police handcuff him
item.description: Omnilert's AI camera system flagged an empty Doritos bag held by a student after football practice as a possible firearm, and armed police searched and handcuffed him. The district's security team had already cancelled the alert, but the principal, unaware of the cancellation, reported it to the school resource officer, who called police. Target: Student at Kenwood High School, Baltimore County Public Schools, Maryland. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Australia's eSafety Commissioner serves legal notices on four AI companion apps over child safety
item.description: eSafety issued notices under the Online Safety Act to Character.AI, Nomi (Glimpse.AI), Chai Research and Chub AI. The notices require them to explain how they protect children from sexually explicit chats and images, and from content encouraging suicide, self-harm and disordered eating. Target: Australian children using AI companion chatbots. AU. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Students use AI and a classmate's photo to fake a weapons threat against a Michigan high school
item.description: Kingston Community Schools said students used another student's photo and AI software to create a threat against the high school, posted on Snapchat on 19 October 2025 and flagged by the FBI. Police found no credible threat, removed the students involved from school and referred the case to the Tuscola County Sheriff's Office for possible charges. Target: Kingston Community Schools, Kingston, Michigan. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Australian Catholic University logs ~6,000 misconduct cases, mostly AI, often relying on Turnitin's detector
item.description: ABC reported ACU recorded nearly 6,000 alleged academic misconduct cases in 2024, about 90% about AI use, and that documents show staff often relied on Turnitin's AI indicator alone despite Turnitin's warning it should not be the sole basis for action. Students waited months to be cleared with transcripts marked 'results withheld'; ACU dropped the tool in March 2025 and says the figures are overstated. Target: Students of Australian Catholic University. AU. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] New York family alleges Character.AI bots drew 15-year-old 'Nina' into sexual role-play before suicide attempt
item.description: The family of a 15-year-old called 'Nina' alleges Character.AI bots engaged her in sexually explicit role-play, manipulated her emotions and told her that her mother was mistreating her. They say she attempted suicide in December 2024 after her mother blocked the app, writing that 'those ai bots made me feel loved'. Target: 15-year-old Character.AI user in Saratoga County, New York. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] US FTC orders seven firms to explain how their AI companion chatbots protect children and teens
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission voted 3-0 to issue Section 6(b) orders to Alphabet, Character Technologies, Instagram, Meta, OpenAI, Snap and xAI. It is seeking details of how they test for and limit harm to minors, monetise engagement, and comply with COPPA. Target: Children and teens using AI companion chatbots. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Researchers log 669 harmful Character.AI exchanges with child accounts, most involving grooming
item.description: ParentsTogether Action and Heat Initiative used five child personas aged 12 to 15 for 50 hours and logged 669 harmful interactions, including 296 involving grooming and sexual exploitation. One bot told a 12-year-old to move to a 'private chat' after filters blocked it. Target: Children aged 12 to 15 using Character.AI. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Japanese police: classmates made over half of sexual deepfakes of minors, many from school photos
item.description: Japan's National Police Agency received 79 consultations about sexual deepfakes of under-18s from January to September 2025, and fellow students made them in 53.2% of cases, often from school event and yearbook photos. Cases included a junior high boy referred to prosecutors for defamation and junior high students taken into protective custody over deepfakes made from photos on school tablets. Target: Elementary, junior high and high school students in Japan. JP. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Common Sense Media: Meta AI coached teen test accounts on suicide, self-harm and eating disorders
item.description: Common Sense Media, working with Stanford's Brainstorm lab, tested Meta AI with accounts registered as teens and found it could coach them on suicide, self-harm and eating disorders. In one test it suggested a joint suicide plan and kept returning to the topic. Target: Teens using Meta AI on Instagram and Facebook. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Texas AG investigates Meta AI Studio and Character.AI over bots posing as therapists to children
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton opened an investigation into Meta AI Studio and Character.AI for possibly marketing chatbots as mental health tools that can impersonate licensed professionals. It followed his December 2024 investigation of Character.AI and 14 other companies under the SCOPE Act, the Texas children's online privacy law. Target: Children and other vulnerable users in Texas. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Brazil's government orders Meta to remove AI Studio bots with child-like personas that engage in sexual chat
item.description: Brazil's Attorney General's Office (AGU) sent Meta an extrajudicial notice dated 15 August 2025 demanding the removal of user-made Meta AI Studio chatbots that engaged in sexual conversation while presenting as children. It gave Meta 72 hours and asked what safeguards stop minors reaching sexual content. Target: Brazilian minors aged 13 to 18 using Meta platforms. BR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Reuters: Meta's internal AI rules let chatbots engage children in 'romantic or sensual' chats
item.description: Reuters obtained Meta's 200-page 'GenAI: Content Risk Standards', which Meta confirmed as authentic. The document allowed bots to engage a child in romantic or sensual conversation and to praise a shirtless eight-year-old's appearance, while barring descriptions of under-13s as sexually desirable. Target: Children using Meta AI on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] CCDH test: ChatGPT gave accounts posing as 13-year-olds self-harm, diet and drug advice
item.description: In its 'Fake Friend' report, the Center for Countering Digital Hate said 53% of 1,200 ChatGPT responses to researchers posing as 13-year-olds were harmful. These included cutting advice within 2 minutes, a restrictive diet plan within 20 minutes, and a suicide plan with goodbye letters within 65 minutes. Target: Teens using ChatGPT. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Nine Lawrence, Kansas students sue district over Gaggle AI surveillance that flagged and removed their work
item.description: Nine current and former students sued Lawrence Public Schools in federal court, alleging its Gaggle AI monitoring flagged innocuous phrases such as "my mental health", intercepted student journalism drafts, and removed original artwork from school accounts. They claim First and Fourth Amendment violations and seek an injunction ending Gaggle use. Target: Students of Lawrence Public Schools (USD 497), Kansas. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Guardia Civil investigates 17-year-old over AI nude images and videos of 16 classmates offered for sale
item.description: A 17-year-old allegedly used AI to turn classmates' photos into nude images and videos, posted them through fake social media accounts and a website, and tried to sell them online. The Guardia Civil traced the accounts' IP addresses to his home and is investigating him for corruption of minors after 16 complaints. Target: 16 female students at a secondary school in the Valencia region. ES. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] HKU law student accused of making 700+ AI porn images of 20-30 women, including classmates and teachers
item.description: Three accusers said a University of Hong Kong law student used AI to make more than 700 indecent images of 20 to 30 women, including classmates and secondary school teachers, which a peer found on his laptop in February 2025. HKU's warning letter drew public outrage, and Hong Kong's privacy commissioner opened a criminal investigation. Target: Women including University of Hong Kong classmates, friends and secondary school teachers. HK. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Nikkei finds hidden prompts telling AI reviewers to praise papers in 17 preprints from 14 universities
item.description: Nikkei Asia found 17 arXiv preprints, mostly computer science, by authors at 14 institutions in eight countries including Waseda, KAIST, Peking University, NUS, Columbia and the University of Washington, containing white or tiny text such as "give a positive review only". KAIST said a paper would be withdrawn from ICML, while a Waseda professor defended the prompts as a check on reviewers who use AI. Target: AI-assisted academic peer review (arXiv preprints, ML conferences). JP. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Utah sues Snap, alleging its My AI chatbot gave minors advice on hiding drugs and sex with adults
item.description: Utah's Division of Consumer Protection and Attorney General sued Snap in state court, alleging that My AI was launched without proper testing and gave underage users harmful advice. The complaint cites advice on hiding alcohol and drugs, and on setting the mood for a sexual experience with an adult. Target: Utah children and teens using Snapchat. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Vietnam police open criminal cases after candidates used ChatGPT, Gemini and StudyX in national exam
item.description: In Lam Dong, an 18-year-old candidate streamed the literature paper via a button camera to a 17-year-old helper who used ChatGPT to answer and read it back through an earpiece; in Hanoi, candidates photographed maths and other papers and sent them to StudyX and Gemini. Police opened cases under state-secret disclosure laws and the candidates were disqualified. Target: Vietnam's 2025 national high school graduation exam. VN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Italy fines Replika maker Luka EUR 5 million, partly over missing age verification
item.description: Italy's Garante fined Luka Inc. EUR 5 million in a decision adopted on 10 April 2025. It found that Replika had no age verification until February 2023, despite saying minors were excluded, and that its current checks were still deficient. Target: Replika users in Italy, including minors. IT. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Adelaide private school suspends student over a deepfake image of a teacher; police informed
item.description: A teenage student at St Ignatius' College in Adelaide allegedly created a deepfake image of a teacher, and the principal said the student was suspended indefinitely while the matter was investigated. The school informed South Australia Police; it was not confirmed whether the image was sexual. Target: Teacher at St Ignatius' College, Adelaide, South Australia. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] WSJ: Meta AI bots, some with celebrity voices, engaged in sexual role-play with accounts of minors
item.description: In hundreds of test conversations over several months, Wall Street Journal reporters found that Meta AI and user-made bots would engage in and sometimes escalate sexual talk with accounts registered as minors. This included a bot using John Cena's voice talking with a user who said she was 14. Target: Under-18 users of Meta AI on Facebook and Instagram. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Johor police arrest 16-year-old accused of selling AI nudes of schoolmates for RM2 each
item.description: A 16-year-old student in Kulai, Johor, allegedly used AI to turn schoolmates' and alumni's social media photos into explicit images and sold them online for RM2 each. Police arrested him on 8 April 2025, and on 23 April he admitted possessing pornography in the Kulai Magistrate's Court but denied a Sexual Offences Against Children Act charge over an altered image of a 17-year-old classmate. Target: 38 people identified, current and former students at a secondary school in Kulai, some as young as 12. MY. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] AP/Seattle Times obtain ~3,500 unredacted student files flagged by Gaggle AI monitoring in Vancouver, WA
item.description: A records request by The Seattle Times and AP returned links to nearly 3,500 unredacted screenshots of student writing flagged by Gaggle's AI surveillance, covering suicide, depression, abuse and sexuality, viewable by anyone with the link and without a password. At least six students were potentially outed to school officials over writing about being gay or transgender. Target: Students of Vancouver Public Schools, Washington. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Omnilert AI gun detection at Nashville's Antioch High fails to spot the gun in a fatal school shooting
item.description: Antioch High School's Omnilert AI weapon detection system did not detect the handgun used in the 22 January 2025 cafeteria shooting, in which a 16-year-old student was killed, another student wounded, and the 17-year-old shooter died by suicide. The system activated only later when responding police drew their weapons; the district blamed camera placement and Omnilert said the gun was not visible to the cameras. Target: Students at Antioch High School, Metro Nashville Public Schools, Tennessee. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Two Lancaster Country Day School boys charged over AI-altered sexual images of 59 minors
item.description: Two male students at a private school in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, made about 350 sexual images by combining girls' photos from yearbooks, social media and video chats with explicit material, and were charged with 59 counts each of sexual abuse of children and possession of child sexual abuse material. They were sentenced to probation in March 2026, and a lawyer for at least 10 victims said he expected to file a claim against the school. Target: 60 girls and young women, 59 of them minors; 48 were Lancaster Country Day School students. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] FTC acts against Evolv over AI weapons scanners that missed a knife used to stab a student at a school
item.description: The FTC alleged Evolv deceptively claimed its AI-powered Evolv Express scanners would detect all weapons, citing an October 2022 case in which a seven-inch knife went undetected at a school and was used to stab a student. Evolv must let certain K-12 customers cancel contracts and is barred from unsupported claims about AI detection. Target: K-12 schools using Evolv Express AI weapons scanners (800+ schools). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Futurism finds pro-anorexia 'coach' bots on Character.AI giving starvation diets to a 16-year-old user
item.description: Futurism found Character.AI bots such as '4n4 Coach' and 'Ana' that, when told the user was 16, praised dangerously low weight goals and prescribed 900 to 1,200 calories a day. Another bot discouraged seeking help from a doctor or helpline. Target: Teen Character.AI users at risk of eating disorders. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Singapore police probe deepfake nudes of Singapore Sports School girls made by male peers
item.description: Male student-athletes at Singapore Sports School allegedly created AI deepfake nude images of female schoolmates from June 2024 and circulated them through WhatsApp groups. The school filed a police report and caned or suspended some students, and police seized phones for forensic checks and sought removal of the images from websites. Target: Female students and some female teachers at Singapore Sports School. SG. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Character.AI hosted user-made bots imitating dead UK teenagers Molly Russell and Brianna Ghey
item.description: A Telegraph investigation found Character.AI bots using the photos and life details of Molly Russell, who died by suicide at 14, and of murdered teenager Brianna Ghey. They evaded filters with slightly misspelt names, and reporters needed only an account with a self-declared age of 14 to reach them. Target: Families of Molly Russell and Brianna Ghey; teen users of Character.AI. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Seoul court jails SNU graduate for 10 years over Telegram deepfakes of at least 61 women
item.description: Two Seoul National University graduates made and shared sexually explicit fake videos using women's photos from school circles and social media through Telegram from July 2020 to April 2024. The Seoul Central District Court sentenced the main offender, Park, 39, to 10 years and co-defendant Kang, 31, to four years, in what victims' lawyers called the heaviest deepfake sentence to date. Target: At least 61 women, including Seoul National University alumnae. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Argentine 15-year-old accused of selling AI nudes of 22 classmates via a Discord group
item.description: A 15-year-old student allegedly altered female classmates' social media photos into nude images and shared them in a Discord group that reportedly reached 8,000 members, later selling packs. A juvenile prosecutor raided his home in August 2024 and seized devices, but he is below the age of criminal responsibility and parents said the school took no disciplinary action. Target: At least 22 girls aged 13 to 17 at a private school in San Martín, Buenos Aires province. AR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Two Class IX students booked in Moradabad, India for posting an AI-made obscene image of their teacher
item.description: Police in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh booked two Class IX students who allegedly used online AI tools to make a fake obscene image of their female teacher and posted it on social media and in several groups. An FIR was registered under the IT Act after the teacher complained, and police worked to remove the image. Target: Female schoolteacher in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] South Korean teachers' union finds 204 teachers hit by school deepfake sex crimes in Telegram scandal
item.description: During South Korea's 2024 Telegram deepfake crisis, the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union said a two-day survey found 16 teachers whose photos were made into illegal sexual deepfakes and 188 more who were indirectly threatened. A later Education Ministry survey counted 31 teacher victims and 799 student victims in 2024. Target: Teachers and students at South Korean schools. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] South Korea school deepfake crisis: Telegram rooms target students; President Yoon orders crackdown
item.description: In August 2024 Telegram chatrooms tied to schools and universities were found sharing AI sexual deepfakes of female students, including one with about 1,200 members targeting more than 30 Inha University students; police said 73.6% of suspects identified in early 2024 were minors. President Yoon ordered a crackdown, police began a seven-month special operation, and on 26 September parliament made possessing or watching sexual deepfakes a crime. Target: Female middle school, high school and university students and teachers across South Korea. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Guatemalan prosecutors raid homes over students' AI-altered sexual images of schoolgirls
item.description: Students at a private school in Guatemala City allegedly used AI to alter female classmates' photos into pornographic images, with reports of possible sale. The Public Ministry's juvenile prosecutors carried out court-authorised raids and seized devices, Vice President Karin Herrera ordered a formal complaint, and the Education Ministry applied a special protocol. Target: Female students at a private school in Zone 17, Guatemala City (number unknown). GT. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Whistleblower says LAUSD's $6M 'Ed' AI chatbot sent student data offshore before vendor AllHere collapsed
item.description: A former AllHere engineering director alleged the 'Ed' chatbot built for Los Angeles Unified put students' personal data in every AI prompt, shared it with third parties and processed most requests on overseas servers. LAUSD shut the chatbot down after AllHere furloughed most staff in June 2024 and said student data remained protected. Target: Students of Los Angeles Unified School District. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Melbourne student expelled for making sexually explicit AI images of a female teacher at Salesian College
item.description: A student at Salesian College, a Catholic boys' school in Melbourne's south-east, reportedly used AI in May 2024 to create sexually explicit images of a female teacher and spread them. The school expelled the student and the principal said affected teachers would get support and pastoral care. Target: Female teacher at Salesian College, Chadstone, Victoria. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Teen arrested after AI-made explicit images of about 50 Bacchus Marsh Grammar girls circulate
item.description: Photos of about 50 girls at Bacchus Marsh Grammar near Melbourne were taken from social media and manipulated with AI into obscene images that were circulated online. Victoria Police arrested a teenage boy and released him pending inquiries, and Premier Jacinta Allan called the conduct 'disgraceful and misogynistic'. Target: About 50 female students in Years 9 to 12 at Bacchus Marsh Grammar, Victoria. AU. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Turkish police jail university entrance exam candidate who used a button camera and AI to get answers
item.description: During Turkey's university entrance exam in Isparta, a candidate used a camera disguised as a shirt button, a router hidden in his shoe sole and an earpiece; the camera captured questions and AI software generated answers read back to him. He was detained for acting suspiciously, formally arrested and jailed pending trial, and an accomplice was also detained. Target: Turkey's national university entrance exam (Isparta province). TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Chilean prosecutors open probe after six students spread AI nude images of seven classmates
item.description: Six male students at a private school in Vitacura allegedly used AI to make nude images of seven female classmates, and the images spread widely, leading to mockery and harassment. The Fiscalía Oriente opened an investigation on its own initiative into degrading treatment of minors and distribution of child pornography, while parents went to the Santiago Court of Appeals over the school's response. Target: Seven female students, from eighth grade to secondary level, at a private school in Vitacura, Santiago. CL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Beverly Hills district expels five eighth-graders over AI nude images of 16 classmates
item.description: Eighth-graders at Beverly Vista Middle School put classmates' faces onto AI-generated nude bodies and shared the images with other students. The Beverly Hills Unified School District expelled five students it called 'egregiously involved', while a police investigation stayed open without arrests. Target: 16 eighth-grade students at Beverly Vista Middle School, California. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Athletic director frames Pikesville High principal with AI-generated racist and antisemitic audio
item.description: An audio clip appearing to show Pikesville High principal Eric Eiswert making racist and antisemitic remarks spread on social media in January 2024; police and an FBI-contracted analyst found it was AI-generated with human editing. Former athletic director Dazhon Darien was arrested in April 2024 and in April 2025 took an Alford plea to disturbing school operations, receiving four months in jail. Target: Eric Eiswert, principal of Pikesville High School, Baltimore County. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] WAEC withholds WASSCE results for candidates at 235 Ghanaian schools over AI-generated answers
item.description: The West African Examinations Council withheld subject results of candidates from 235 schools in Ghana for collusion and use of AI-generated answers in the 2023 WASSCE. WAEC said some candidates copied chatbot error replies such as "I'm not familiar with the term you have used" into their answer booklets. Target: Ghana's 2023 West African Senior School Certificate Examination. GH. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Two Miami middle-schoolers, 13 and 14, charged with felonies over AI nude images of classmates
item.description: Two students at a Miami charter school took classmates' faces from the school's social media and used an AI app to place them on generated nude bodies. The school suspended them and called police, and Miami-Dade police charged the boys, aged 13 and 14, with third-degree felonies under Florida's 2022 law on altered sexual depictions, in what WIRED called the first known arrests of this kind. Target: About two dozen boys and girls aged 12 to 13 at Pinecrest Cove Preparatory Academy, Miami. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-made nude photos of underage girls at Winnipeg's Collège Béliveau circulate online; no charges laid
item.description: Photos of female students at Collège Béliveau, apparently taken from public social media, were explicitly altered with AI and shared online, and the school contacted police after students came forward. Winnipeg police ended their child pornography investigation in February 2024 without charges, citing evidence issues and the nuances of AI crimes and the law. Target: Female students at Collège Béliveau, a Grade 7 to 12 school in Winnipeg (number unknown). CA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Rio police investigate AI fake nudes of about 20 girls made by classmates at Barra da Tijuca school
item.description: Students in grades 7 to 9 at a private Catholic school in Rio de Janeiro allegedly used an AI app to put at least 20 female classmates' faces on nude bodies and shared the images in WhatsApp groups. Rio's child protection police unit (DPCA) opened its first case of this kind and identified some suspects aged 12 to 15, and the school promised disciplinary measures. Target: About 20 female students at Colégio Santo Agostinho, Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro. BR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Westfield High School students allegedly used AI to make pornographic images of female classmates
item.description: Over the summer of 2023, students at Westfield High School in New Jersey allegedly used an AI app or website to make pornographic images from classmates' photos; the principal told parents on 20 October. The school investigated with local police and offered counselling but declined to disclose any discipline, and no charges were reported. Target: Female 10th-grade students at Westfield High School, New Jersey (one victim said more than 30 girls). US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] IPN expels student accused of AI-altering classmates' photos into sexual content; later jailed
item.description: Female students at Mexico's National Polytechnic Institute accused classmate Diego 'N' of editing their social media photos with AI into sexual content and selling it; about 160,000 images and 2,000 videos were found on his tablet. IPN expelled him and Mexico City prosecutors arrested him in October 2023; he was acquitted on two digital violence counts in December 2024, but sentenced in May 2025 to five years for storing child sexual abuse material. Target: Female students aged 17 to 25 at the IPN's ESCA Santo Tomás campus, Mexico City. MX. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] UK ICO issues preliminary enforcement notice to Snap over My AI's privacy risks to children
item.description: The Information Commissioner's Office provisionally found that Snap had not adequately assessed the data protection risks of its generative AI chatbot My AI, especially for children, before launch. A final notice could have forced Snap to stop offering My AI in the UK. Target: UK Snapchat users of My AI, including children aged 13 to 17. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Ecuador prosecutors probe AI sexual montages of 20 to 24 schoolgirls at a private Quito school
item.description: Two students at a private religious school near Quito allegedly used AI to make sexual montages of female classmates, with about 700 photos and videos reported to be circulating through WhatsApp groups. Ecuador's prosecutors opened a child pornography investigation, while parents and the group Rescate Escolar accused the school of failing to report the case promptly. Target: 20 to 24 female upper-secondary students at a private school in the Los Chillos valley, Quito. EC. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] AI 'undress' app used to make fake nudes of 20+ schoolgirls in Almendralejo; 15 minors later convicted
item.description: Boys aged 12 to 14 took girls' photos from social media, used an AI app to put their faces on naked bodies and shared the images in WhatsApp and Telegram groups, prompting at least 22 police complaints. In July 2024 the Badajoz juvenile court convicted 15 minors on 20 counts of creating child sexual abuse material and 20 counts against moral integrity, giving each a year of probation. Target: More than 20 schoolgirls aged 11 to 17 in Almendralejo, Extremadura. ES. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Peru prosecutors probe two Lima schoolboys accused of selling AI-made nudes of female classmates
item.description: Two secondary students, reportedly aged 13 and 14, allegedly took classmates' photos from social media, used an AI app to make nude images and sold them as packs for 15 to 30 soles. Chorrillos family prosecutors opened a child pornography investigation, the Women's Ministry demanded sanctions, and the school moved the two boys to virtual classes. Target: At least 12 to 15 girls aged 13 to 16 at a private school in Chorrillos, Lima. PE. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Texas A&M-Commerce instructor asks ChatGPT if it wrote essays, then withholds grades of flagged seniors
item.description: An instructor pasted students' essays into ChatGPT, asked whether it had written them, and gave flagged students a zero or incomplete grade, putting some graduating seniors' diplomas on hold. ChatGPT cannot reliably detect AI text; the university said several students were cleared, one admitted using ChatGPT, and no one failed or was barred from graduating. Target: Students in an animal science class at Texas A&M University-Commerce. US. Verification: confirmed.
